<html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>免费房屋初检｜德屋系统防水技术</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f3f6f9;color:#102a43;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif}.wrap{max-width:680px;margin:auto;background:#fff;min-height:100vh}.header{padding:24px 22px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #e6edf3}.brand{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px}.sub{font-size:12px;color:#66788a;margin-top:5px}.hero{padding:24px 22px 10px}h1{font-size:32px;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 10px}.lead{color:#526779;line-height:1.7}.badges{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}.badge{background:#eaf2fa;color:#124b7a;border-radius:20px;padding:7px 11px;font-size:13px}.card{margin:0 18px 18px;padding:20px;border:1px solid #e1e9f0;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(16,42,67,.06)}label{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;margin:14px 0 7px}input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #cbd7e1;border-radius:10px;font-size:15px;background:#fff}textarea{min-height:90px;resize:vertical}.types{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px}.types label{margin:0;border:1px solid #d5e0e8;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;font-weight:500}.types input{width:auto;margin-right:7px}button{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:15px;background:#0d4777;color:white;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;margin-top:18px}.note{font-size:12px;color:#718096;line-height:1.6;margin-top:12px}.success{display:none;text-align:center;padding:28px 8px}.success h2{font-size:25px}.qr{width:210px;height:210px;object-fit:contain;margin:14px auto}.footer{padding:20px 22px 35px;text-align:center;color:#718096;font-size:12px}
</style></head><body><div class="wrap">
<header class="header"><div class="brand">德屋系统防水技术</div><div class="sub">德国工艺 · 专业检测 · 持久防护</div></header>
<section class="hero"><h1>免费房屋初检</h1><div class="lead">屋顶漏水、墙面渗水、开裂、地下室潮湿、保温老化？上传现场照片，我们先帮您做初步判断。</div><div class="badges"><span class="badge">屋面防水</span><span class="badge">渗漏排查</span><span class="badge">保温评估</span><span class="badge">房屋修缮</span></div></section>
<div class="card" id="formCard"><form id="inspectionForm">
<label>所在小区 *</label><input name="community" required="" placeholder="例如：XX花园">
<label>楼栋 / 房号</label><input name="room" placeholder="例如：8栋1202室">
<label>房龄</label><select name="age"><option value="">请选择</option><option>5年以内</option><option>5–10年</option><option>10–20年</option><option>20年以上</option><option>不清楚</option></select>
<label>主要问题 *</label><div class="types">
<label><input type="checkbox" name="problem" value="屋顶漏水">屋顶漏水</label><label><input type="checkbox" name="problem" value="墙面渗水">墙面渗水</label>
<label><input type="checkbox" name="problem" value="墙体开裂">墙体开裂</label><label><input type="checkbox" name="problem" value="地下室潮湿">地下室潮湿</label>
<label><input type="checkbox" name="problem" value="保温老化">保温老化</label><label><input type="checkbox" name="problem" value="防水老化">防水老化</label></div>
<label>问题描述</label><textarea name="description" placeholder="例如：下雨后卧室墙角出现水印……"></textarea>
<label>上传照片</label><input type="file" name="photos" accept="image/*" multiple=""><div class="note">建议上传3–6张：问题近照、全景、窗边/墙角/屋顶等位置照片。</div>
<label>姓名 *</label><input name="name" required="" placeholder="怎么称呼您">
<label>联系电话 *</label><input name="phone" required="" type="tel" placeholder="手机号">
<button type="submit">提交免费检测申请</button><div class="note">提交即表示您同意我们为本次房屋初检联系您。照片和联系方式仅用于检测沟通。</div>
</form></div>
<div class="card success" id="success"><div style="font-size:46px">✓</div><h2>申请已提交</h2><p>感谢您的提交。我们会根据您提供的信息进行初步分析。</p><p><b>如需补充现场照片，请添加微信：</b></p>
<img class="qr" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="微信二维码"><p>微信：19963784117</p></div>
<footer class="footer">德屋系统防水技术 · 合肥及周边<br>房屋体检｜防水修缮｜保温施工｜屋面翻新</footer></div>
<script>
document.getElementById('inspectionForm').addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();document.getElementById('formCard').style.display='none';document.getElementById('success').style.display='block';window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});});
</script></body></html>
